Q: L1 data eviction to L2 A:

Historically at least, some non-x86 CPUs with truly VIPT caches required the OS to do page-colouring (making sure the low bit of the phys page-number matches the low bit of the virtual page address) to avoid synonym problems, while an extra tag bit avoids homonym problems (as well as providing the full physical address if/when needed for write-back to outer caches). Virtually indexed physically tagged cache Synonym has a diagram that's apparently real for MIPS R4000

A Unix workstation with a CPU like this would not be unheard-of, especially with a vendor like Sun or SGI that designed and sold the hardware (Sparc or MIPS) with their OS installed. I'm not sure how 3rd-party portable OSes like *BSD or Linux would go about detecting when a CPU needs page-colouring to avoid synonym problems when the same physical page is mapped at multiple virtual addresses.

Q: Why isn't the second Modal working to navigate images like the first one is? A:

Update: I found the solution to my problem. In my code, I have each modal with the same name in this tag:

<div id="carouselExampleIndicators" class="carousel slide">

I renamed each modal component to have a unique id in the div’s id = " " and all of the data-bs-target=#name—and, whalah, like magic, all the carousels open into the proper modal with images that are clickable.

Q: Excel VBA IDE keeps a workbook's project open after the workbook has been closed A:

This isn't an answer to "How can this be fixed", but it is a partial answer to "What is causing this behaviour." I won't mark this as the accepted answer in case someone actually posts a work-around.

After much investigation, I have determined it is a bug in Excel, Office 365, plain and simple, and has nothing to do with any VBA code within a spreadsheet. It also has nothing to do with OneDrive. Hence @TimWilliams' comment above is pretty much on-the-mark. It can be reproduced trivially with the following steps:

  1. Open a clean fresh instance of Excel, with a new blank workbook.

  2. Open the VBA IDE and insert a plain, simple module. In that module, put the following trivial code: option explicit

  3. Save the workbook as say ghostExample.xlsm, but do not close it yet.

  4. With the file menu, open another blank workbook.

  5. Close the first workbook.

At this point, if you switch to the VBA IDE, you will see that the VBA project from the first workbook is still open. Each time you open and close ghostExample.xlsm, it adds another copy of the project to the IDE.

Edit: this is in "Microsoft® Excel® for Microsoft 365 MSO (Version 2512 Build 16.0.19530.20144) 64-bit" running in Windows 10.0.19045 Build 19045. Security Macro settings: "Disable VBA macros with notification", and "Trust access to the VBA project object model" both selected, though I get the same behaviour without trusting access to the VBA project object model. I get the same behaviour on a Windows 11 machine (10.0.26100 Build 26100) running Microsoft® Excel® for Microsoft 365 MSO (Version 2601 Build 16.0.19628.20150) 64-bit.

Q: Kafka consumer group and partition assingment A:

As you are using the default "range assignor", the behavior you see is expected. The "range assignor" assigns all partitions with the same number to the same client. As you have 10 partitions, the first member in the group get partition zero for all topics assigned, and the second member partition one for all topics, and so on. The JavaDocs explain this strategy: https://kafka.apache.org/39/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/RangeAssignor.html

If you want the partitions to get spread out evenly, you would want to use "round robin" assignor instead: https://kafka.apache.org/39/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/RoundRobinAssignor.html

Q: JOIN two tables using a linking table with CodeIgniter's query builder A:

I think this line is incorrect 

$this->db->join('table3', 'table2.record_id= table3.record_desc');

because table3.record_desc is not the foreign key from table 2 to table 3 right ?

The query may be like this 

$this->db->join('table3', 'table2.record_id= table3.record_id');

because you have to have a foreign key to match records in table 2 and table 3 .

and when you are selecting the result if you are doing like 

$this->db->select('*');

If you have same column name in each table , only one column will appear in the result .

so try to get only columns you want like this 

$this->db->select('table1.id,table2.record_id,table3.record_desc');

Hope this helps .

Q: Kafka Streams: Is it possible to filter records before materializing a GlobalKTable? A:

If you are using addGlobalStore(...) instead of globalKTable(...) you can provide a custom Processor which allows you to modify the data in-flight -- ie, Processor.process() is called for each input record from the "global topic", and the processor must put the record into the state store -- but before doing the put() it can modify the record.

Note, that you need to be using Kafka Streams version 3.8.0 or newer -- before 3.8.0 it was not allowed inside a custom Processor to modify the records in-flight (cf https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/KAFKA-7663).
